parameters.name: block_affine

parameters.name: block_affine_pyramid_level
parameters.description: OME-Zarr pyramid level for block-affine seam measurements (0 = full resolution)

parameters.name: input_dataset_s3
parameters.description: Test runs: stage inputs from an existing processed asset (s3://bucket/asset) instead of /data; empty = /data

parameters.name: smoke_test
parameters.description: 1: only import the code and exit (cheap Reproducible Run before API pipeline launches)
